title: Spring Security Advisories - 2026-07-29
description:
Merged 6 spring security advisories published on 2026-07-29. Original advisory IDs: CVE-2026-47858, CVE-2026-47873, CVE-2026-47882, CVE-2026-59326, CVE-2026-59327, CVE-2026-59328

Titles:
- cve-2026-47858 - HIGH - CVE-2026-47858: live information startup mode is vulnerable for remote code execution
- cve-2026-47873 - HIGH - CVE-2026-47873: Spring Tools Docker integration publishes unauthenticated debug (JDWP) and JMX ports on all network interfaces
- cve-2026-47882 - LOW - CVE-2026-47882: Spring Boot DevTools remote secret generated with a non-cryptographic PRNG
- cve-2026-59326 - LOW - CVE-2026-59326: HTTP Proxy Credentials Logged in Plaintext by the Spring Boot Language Server
- cve-2026-59327 - MEDIUM - CVE-2026-59327: Cleartext Storage of Spring Boot DevTools Remote Secret in Eclipse Launch Configurations
- cve-2026-59328 - MEDIUM - CVE-2026-59328: Cross-Site Scripting in Eclipse Spring Boot Starter Wizard Dependency Tooltips
